decisions.decision: The COA is not able to hold fundraisers as it is a Town Department; the Advocacy Committee should collaborate with the Eagle House Supporters on the Festival of Trees.
decisions.quote: it was determined that the coa is not able to hold fundraisers as they are a town department and they should look at collaborating with the eagle house supporters on this endeavor.

decisions.decision: The Director will look into increasing Outreach staffing, as the Town Manager does not want Town buildings opened on Fridays.
decisions.quote: ms. noble said that the town manager does not want to open town buildings on fridays and she will look into increasing outreach staffing.

decisions.decision: The Advocacy Committee will post a meeting at 9AM on April 9, 2013 to discuss the Festival of Trees event.
decisions.quote: the advocacy committee will post a meeting at 9am on april 9, 2013 for further discussion on this event.

decisions.decision: Barbara Brown will work on the ByLaw changes on outgoing sub-committee chairpersons' responsibilities and present corrections at the April COA meeting.
decisions.quote: barbara brown reported that she will be working on the bylaw changes concerning outgoing coa sub- committee chairpersons responsibilities and will present corrections at the april coa meeting

decisions.decision: The Advocacy Committee minutes of December 11, 2012 will be voted on at the April COA Board meeting.
decisions.quote: these will be voted on at the april coa board meeting.

decisions.decision: A COA orientation date will be set with Ms. O’Dea and Ms. Lacka by the Director, the Chairperson and the Vice Chairperson.
decisions.quote: a coa orientation date will be set with ms. o'dea and ms. lacka with the director and the coa chairperson and vice chairperson.

decisions.decision: The Tuesday meal site pizza and hotdogs menu will be discontinued; the normal MOC meal will continue that day.
decisions.quote: the tuesday meal site menu of pizza and hotdogs is not going as well as planned and will be discontinued.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: No COA monthly financial page was available for the meeting because of vendor changes and monies being moved between budget lines to cover shortages.
budget_items.quote: there was no coa monthly financial page available for this meeting due to the fact that there have been some vendor changes

budget_items.topic: FY14 utility lines moved to Central Purchasing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager removed the utility lines from the COA FY14 Budget and placed them into Central Purchasing through the DPW.
budget_items.quote: the town manager has decided to remove the utility lines from the coa fy14 budget and place into central purchasing through the dpw.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Money collected for the COA at Lunenburg Relief Day sits in a Gift Account, not the FY14 Town Budget; the Director hopes to use it for Friday transportation costs, and Mr. Lincoln asked whether it could fund Outreach positions or a benefit position.
budget_items.quote: the monies collected for the coa last summer at the lunenburg relief day

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Director hopes to draw on the gift account money for Friday transportation costs.
budget_items.quote: she is hoping to draw on that money for friday transportation costs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town employees receive a stipend after 10 years of benefit service, a small percentage of yearly wage built into the budget each year.
budget_items.quote: after 10 years of benefit service to the town

transfers.description: Line-item transfers of monies from one budget line to another to cover shortages, following vendor changes.
transfers.quote: we are in the process of transferring monies from one line to another to cover shortages.
